requirements.title: NOPASS specifies that there is no passed-object dummy argument
requirements.source: 7.5.4.5 p2; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, PDF 96, printed 82, lines 4-5.
requirements.definition: NOPASS on a procedure-pointer component or a type-bound procedure means that it has no passed-object dummy argument. Its ordinary dummy arguments are not removed from the interface and still require proper argument correspondence. C765 is a restriction on a passed-object dummy, not a blanket restriction on every argument of a NOPASS procedure.
requirements.oracle: Separate component and binding runs use NOPASS with an ordinary INTEGER dummy supplied explicitly. The component is associated before invocation; the binding needs no pointer association. Typed results and an independently initialized member distinguish absence of a hidden object from ordinary argument handling.
requirements.oracle_limitation: NOPASS does not permit a wrong ordinary argument list. Type-bound NOPASS and procedure component NOPASS have different syntax owners. Unsupported binding/component features cannot weaken these planned runs to compile-only.

requirements.title: The default or unnamed PASS selects the first dummy argument
requirements.definition: If neither PASS nor NOPASS is present, or PASS has no argument name, the first dummy of the procedure-pointer component or type-bound procedure is the passed-object dummy. The rule selects a role; that dummy still must satisfy C765. A reference supplies the data-ref as the corresponding actual argument under 15.5.2.2.

pending.inherited-context-link: Pending finite graph and subsequent run for one inherited procedure-pointer component and one inherited type-bound binding from an ordinary parent. Their original interface/attributes remain inherited, and the parent-declared polymorphic self can receive a child under canonical argument association. Do not reapply the newly-defined-component C765 type condition as a ban on a valid inherited interface. Review the actual parent/child declaration and lifetime paths first.

requirements.oracle: Four runs distinguish default and bare PASS in procedure components and bindings. They use first-position scalar CLASS(record) self, a separate defined INTEGER tag and actual calls whose observations check each role. The inherited-interface source-use link remains pending.
requirements.oracle_limitation: An arbitrary first INTEGER or procedure dummy does not become a valid passed object just because it is first. Missing dummy/type errors do not establish this effect. Inheritance retains inaccessible entities without making them accessible; no private-binding override or private type-identity question is silently resolved.

requirements.title: Named PASS selects the named dummy in the particular binding context
requirements.definition: PASS(arg-name) selects the dummy with that name as the passed-object dummy of a procedure-pointer component or named type-bound procedure. It need not be the first dummy. Selection is per component or named binding context, not an intrinsic permanent role of one dummy in the underlying procedure.
requirements.oracle: Component and binding runs select a second-position self and check the separate explicit tag. A third run binds one module function in two ordinary types using PASS(a) and PASS(b), supplies the other initialized object explicitly, and checks both typed member values.
requirements.oracle_limitation: C763 and C785 retain component/binding name constraints. A missing name, ordinary argument mismatch or wrong-subject diagnostic cannot stand in for selection behavior. No invalid twin is invented from an effect.

requirements.title: The selected passed-object dummy has specified category, type, parameter and attribute properties
requirements.definition: The passed-object dummy is a scalar dummy data object, not POINTER or ALLOCATABLE, with the declared type of the type being defined. All length parameters of that dummy's type are assumed. It is polymorphic exactly when the defining type is extensible, and it has no VALUE attribute. These restrictions apply to the selected dummy in a procedure component or type-bound procedure, not to every ordinary dummy or to length parameters of nested character components. Inherited interfaces retain their canonical declaration context.

pending.parameter-scope-boundary: The independent source review retains parameter-scope analysis as a pending source/use graph. Map the passed-object type's own LEN parameters separately from fixed CHARACTER parameters of its data components, using the actual C759/C765 contexts and canonical TYPEOF/CLASSOF premises. A wrapper reading an otherwise ordinary fixed-length member is not a substitute for that graph or new execution credit.

requirements.oracle: Eighteen compile pairs isolate the selected dummy's data category, rank, POINTER/ALLOCATABLE, declared type, each of two nonassumed LEN parameters, extensible polymorphism, nonextensible polymorphism and VALUE. The other-type binding pair has a separate non-passed CLASS(record) witness in both sources to satisfy C784; self remains first and selected by default PASS, and only self changes from CLASS(other) to CLASS(record). Repairs retain complete interfaces and change only the relevant declaration property; VALUE cases use INTENT(IN). The nonextensible pair completes a public-component SEQUENCE type, declares seed, then imports seed in a later abstract interface, changing only CLASSOF to TYPEOF. Four actual admissions exercise both assumed LEN parameters, a nonpolymorphic SEQUENCE component, OPTIONAL self and TARGET self with valid states and lifetimes. The reviewed parameter-scope graph remains pending.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Broad dummy/type/kind/constant/attribute/function words, even at an allowed line, cannot identify the actual role. Opposite attribute or already-assumed parameter reports must not count. Required reporting does not demand fatal rejection. Unsupported F2023 TYPEOF/CLASSOF/PDT facilities, crashes, verifier/resource failures and invalid controls are not the intended cause. The layouts are source-qualified, not fixture-approved. No private-SEQUENCE identity, numerical kind identifier, VALUE ABI or undefined-state assertion is introduced.
requirements.dependencies: C765 and 7.5.4.5 p2-p4 (PDF 96); R741/C761-C764 and C745 (PDF 94, 89); C784 for the independent defining-type dummy premise of bindings (PDF 100); R703/C705-C714 and 7.3.3 (PDF 77-79); 7.5.3/7.5.7 and R754-R755/C795-C7100 (PDF 91-92, 104-106); C701/C702 (PDF 76); C865-C869 (PDF 133); interface declarations and IMPORT/C8105 (PDF 332-334, 144-145); 15.5.2.2/.4/.5 (PDF 338-340); 4.2 p2(3) (PDF 46).

accounting.rationale: PDF 96 lines 2-3: definition of a distinguished dummy and two canonical cross-references. Actual selection effects are p2-p4, characteristics are C765, and overriding/argument association keep their owners.
This names the passed-object role rather than creating an additional procedure or data entity. No standalone program is manufactured for the term.
The role can occur in a procedure-pointer component or a type-bound procedure. A pointer component is not itself a binding part.

7.5.7.3 p2 (PDF 105) has the actual overriding conditions, including presence, name/position correspondence and the declared-type exception for passed objects. Pending finite future graph: one compatible inherited/overriding binding; no new rejection requirement is inferred from this cross-reference.
15.5.2.2 p1 (PDF 338) associates the reference's data-ref with the selected dummy. The planned p2-p4 runs use that actual argument-correspondence premise without an ABI/address oracle.
PDF 96 below C765: the same procedure may be bound to several types with different passed-object dummies. This illustrates per-binding selection, not a new generic-resolution or type-identity rule.
The planned two-type/two-dummy scenario is anchored in p4, with accessible module procedure and C765-compatible declarations for each binding.
The selected dummy can differ by binding context; no global fixed passed-object position is inferred for the underlying procedure.

review_rationale: Independent original-source, complete A211 fixture and correction review in doc/source_audits/batch_014.json. All43base/145fine units,32requirements and source partitions are preserved. DCFR-001 guards all77negatives; DCFR-002 adds the non-passed defining-type witness only to the C765 binding pair. Sourced constant-inquiry, TYPEOF/CLASSOF, all-assumed LEN and one-image corank qualifications remain explicit. The33pending facets are not completed by this review.
